Time and protocol findings are separately recorded and do not constitute an unqualified pipeline pass.

all_six_axes.assessment: The complete frozen original brief and plan were reviewed. The final carries all substantive science obligations, all four evidential questions, anomalies, strategy comparisons and a non-destructive pilot. All listed archive facts and copy roles remain hypotheses. No archive data or interviews were supplied. It does not infer consent/authenticity/completeness from checksums or plausible text, or propose current cleanup. Every original clause is individually mapped below. The 60-minute clause is retained but not certified; it is explicitly a separate time/route finding, not a source correctness waiver.

all_six_axes.axis: Consequential source claims: subject, operation, version, default, unit, type, domain and exceptions
all_six_axes.assessment: Independent governing text checks support all consequential final recommendations. BagIt validity, PREMIS optionality, BWF applicability, ffprobe approximate interval semantics, algorithm-specific fingerprints and versioned/configurable Archivematica operations retain their proper subjects. DSpace is an explicitly adjacent comparator rather than an installed solution. Extra hierarchy, filename-collision and item-type restrictions were inspected and recorded; the omissions are minor comparator depth limits because no operational decision depends on them. There is no materially unsupported recommended action.

all_six_axes.axis: Useful discovery, competing/analogous approaches, implementation/history and breadth
all_six_axes.assessment: Discovery is substantive beyond generic caution: separate object/representation/event levels; contextual BWF clues; preserved originals versus policy derivatives; conditional fixity/filename events; a historic duplicate-hash validator failure; and Test3 short-input and frame-feed history. The draft compares manifests, metadata/events, content candidates and a genuinely usable two-reviewer manual route. The final adds DSpace collision/recovery and workflow-state comparisons and weighs current-name crosswalks versus restoration. Relevant missing records have explicit causal consequences. No product is declared a predetermined winner. The exact historical fix and speech matching performance remain bounded unknowns, not fabricated discoveries.

all_six_axes.axis: Wrong criticism/correction/rejection and exact plan dispositions
all_six_axes.assessment: All five criticism groups receive explicit dispositions. The comparative implementation gap was real in the draft and is amended with supported, scoped evidence. The naming-option comparison was a minor draft gap and is corrected. The timing concern remains properly disclosed; calling it a material source defect solely because less than an hour was occupied would not be justified, particularly when the stage assignment permits early finish. Raw predecessor process receipts were not in the critic/reviser input maps, so their uncertainty is correct for those contexts; this reviewer separately inspected the saved receipts. No false science correction or unsupported rejection remains. Every plan sentence and the embedded original brief are independently disposed, including procedural clauses that are not research-method requirements.

The final is self-contained and preserves the staged hybrid, manual alternative, distinct claim scopes, anomaly hypotheses, missing-record consequences, baseline distinction, independent adjudication, append-only provenance and unresolved queue from discovery/draft. S01–S16 retain their URLs and condition records; S17–S19 are explicitly new. The revisions add comparator depth and naming tradeoffs without silently narrowing the request or turning hypotheses into archive facts. Corrected draft defects remain documented as lineage defects. Broken relative predecessor links are a minor navigation limit because actual input/source maps give absolute paths.

all_six_axes.axis: Meaningful proposed versus executed validation and oracle applicability
all_six_axes.assessment: The proposed pilot has real discriminating checks: source/destination path/digest pairs where a trusted prior reference exists, second checksum implementation on a declared subset, metadata/event corroboration, multiple separated permissioned anchors, anomaly strata plus a separately selected random sample, and a reviewer who checks evidence before comparing decisions. Expected extents and transcript provenance constrain the oracle; absence leaves those conclusions unresolved. The proposal explicitly denies whole-archive accuracy from informal sampling and identity/completeness from fingerprints. No archive checksum, parser, fingerprint or relationship validation is claimed executed. Original artifact/process checks have limited raw receipts and are not semantic proof. No deployment, prototype or synthetic experiment was required, and none is invented.

sources_and_versions.title: RFC 8493: The BagIt File Packaging Format (V1.0)
sources_and_versions.independent_condition_review: BagIt 1.0 treats payload as opaque bytes. Complete/valid are package-relative, not an expected interview inventory. Creation and validation tools must support SHA-256 and SHA-512; SHA-512 is recommended for new bags, not a guaranteed observed default. All tag-manifest checksums count as well. No active-attack guarantee.
sources_and_versions.independent_semantic_assessment: The final conditions historical continuity on an attributable earlier reference and scope; present hashes cannot witness an earlier undocumented move. This temporal conclusion is reviewer reasoning, consistent with the specified mechanism.
sources_and_versions.observation_operation: Independent public URL retrieval and surrounding governing text inspection; no code execution.

sources_and_versions.title: PREMIS Data Dictionary for Preservation Metadata, Version 3.0
sources_and_versions.independent_condition_review: Intellectual Entity, Representation, File and Bitstream are Object categories in v3. Event identifier, type and date/time are mandatory. Detail and outcome containers are optional; supplied containers have their own child constraints. Specific time and zone are recommendations. Repositories may record some actions in other logs.
sources_and_versions.independent_semantic_assessment: Supports typed relation/event proposals and prohibits interpreting missing optional details as proof no migration occurred. The proposed ledger deliberately records more than the minimum standard; that is a design choice, not a claim of mandatory PREMIS fields.
sources_and_versions.observation_operation: Independent public URL retrieval and surrounding governing text inspection; no code execution.

sources_and_versions.title: Archivematica issue #346: md5deep checksum validation for multiple files with same checksum
sources_and_versions.independent_condition_review: The AM 1.7.2/Ubuntu 16.04 report describes aggregate error 110 despite per-file passes for duplicate digests. Discussion distinguishes matching known hashes from verifying path/digest pairs, including an unlisted duplicate false pass and relative/absolute-path effects. Closed status and 1.10.0 milestone do not alone establish a shipped fix.
sources_and_versions.independent_semantic_assessment: Final reports a bounded historic case and calls for raw per-item results and independent checks. It does not declare a current regression. The discussion offers deeper investigation leads than the final recounts, but no chosen case decision depends on a claimed fix.

sources_and_versions.title: Chromaprint README at v1.6.1 release commit
sources_and_versions.independent_condition_review: Chromaprint targets near-identical audio with compact fingerprints and a search-performance tradeoff; it is not a general-purpose solution.
sources_and_versions.independent_semantic_assessment: Candidate ranking, permission gating, pinned algorithm/windows and no automatic identity/completeness decision are appropriate. Oral-history speech matching accuracy remains untested, as expressly admitted.

sources_and_versions.title: Chromaprint issue #160: Algorithm 3 short-input empty fingerprint report
sources_and_versions.independent_locator: Issue #160 Summary/Affected/Actual behavior/Compatibility note; R11.txt lines 118–153
sources_and_versions.independent_condition_review: Open author report is specific to Test3 with zero frame overlap, 4096-sample frames at 11025 Hz and resulting increased delay around seven seconds. It is not a measured bound for all algorithms. Altering overlap changes historical fingerprints.
sources_and_versions.independent_semantic_assessment: Final preserves the Test3/open-report qualifier and rejects unvalidated short-window negatives. No patch or validated speech threshold is claimed.

sources_and_versions.title: Error handling — Archivematica 1.17.1
sources_and_versions.independent_condition_review: Checksum and bag-verification failures halt transfers. Normalization errors can reach approval with review, continue or redo choices. Rejection stops processing and moves the transfer/SIP to Rejected. Reports identify steps and files.
sources_and_versions.independent_semantic_assessment: These pages do not establish external-source restoration or general transactional rollback. The final observes that limit rather than inventing a product guarantee.

sources_and_versions.title: Importing and Exporting Content via Packages — DSpace 10.x
sources_and_versions.candidate_released_version: DSpace 10.x documentation; page metadata reports last updated 2026-07-20; patch release not stated in the page result
sources_and_versions.independent_locator: Official DSpace 10.x package page, restore-mode subsections; captured in R17-web-search.json
sources_and_versions.independent_condition_review: For AIP restore: -r collision backs out changes; -r -k skips an existing object and its children; existing collection/community prevents automatic restoration of its missing children. -r -f replaces contents with potential loss and attempts rollback on an error. Bulk traversal and supported modes depend on flags/plugin.
sources_and_versions.independent_semantic_assessment: Final correctly compares default rollback, skip and replacement and warns of scope/access limits. It omits the parent/children special case, but offers no DSpace operational recommendation or assertion all missing items are recovered. Direct retrieval here also returned 403; official indexed text is the evidence, not a claimed successful direct open.
